postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 and not any(c.isdigit() for c in s)
postconditions.description: If no digits exist in the string, return -1.
If input is not a string, return -1.

postconditions.expression: digits := [int(c) for c in s if c.isdigit()] and product := 1 and all(0 <= d <= 9 for d in digits) and all(d != 0 or len(digits) == 1 for d in digits) and (product := 1 if not digits else product * d for d in digits) and str_product := str(product) and len(str_product) > 0
postconditions.description: Compute the product of all digits in the string, ignoring non-digit characters. If no digits exist, return -1.
If the product has an odd number of digits, return the middle digit.

postconditions.expression: len(str_product) % 2 == 0 and (middle_two := str_product[len(str_product) // 2 - 1 : len(str_product) // 2 + 1]) and (return_value == int(middle_two) if middle_two[0] != '0' else return_value == int(middle_two[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the product has an even number of digits, return the middle two digits as an integer, removing leading zero if present.
